releases.title: MM2 aim and world toggles
changes: Auto Swing on Aim (murderer only, close range, Swing Range slider).
Crosshair label reads Oxide. Hit tracers, Hit Markers, and HitSounds are on the Aim Checks column and default off.
World: Teleport to Gun and Auto Pickup Gun, toggles, default off.
Aim toggles, default off: Teleport to Murderer, Teleport Behind, Sheriff Auto Shoot, Fly to Murderer, Knife Throw, Rage Speed.
Visible Check still blocks locks and sheriff shots through walls.

releases.title: MM2 murderer aim
changes: In Murder Mystery 2, aim locks onto the murderer only. Sheriff and innocents are ignored. If the murderer is not known yet, it does not lock anyone.

releases.title: Coin Farm
changes: Coin Farm on the World page. While on in Murder Mystery 2, collision is off and the character flies to each coin with the camera following. Turning it off, or running out of coins, restores collision and the camera. Coin ESP and Dropped Gun ESP are unchanged.

releases.title: MM2 ESP and player list
changes: Murder Mystery 2 Coin ESP draws a label, a small marker, and the distance on coins that have dropped on the ground. Dropped Gun ESP does the same for the gun lying in the world after someone dies. Both stay off until you turn them on under World.

Players List is a sidebar page that shows everyone else in the server with their name and distance. Teleport moves you a few studs beside them. Spectate follows that player. Unspectate puts the camera back on you.

releases.title: MM2 coin and gun ESP
changes: Murder Mystery 2 Coin ESP draws a label, a small marker, and the distance on coins that have dropped on the ground. Dropped Gun ESP does the same for the gun lying in the world after someone dies. Both stay off until you turn them on under World.
Visible Check skips targets behind walls with a raycast. Mouse, memory, and silent aim were fixed in this build.

releases.title: Blade Ball parry
changes: Auto parry tracks the ball at a high rate and presses once when the predicted time-to-impact enters the window. Timing scales a distance-over-speed lead, Ping Offset shifts that lead in milliseconds, and Ping Compensation adds measured ping.

Curve Aware estimates the curve from velocity changes over a short horizon, then coasts. A bounce drops the curve. Target Check parries only when the ball is coming at you, using the ball's target name and the Highlight on your character.
Parry Input is F, left click, G, or a combination, held long enough for the game to see the press.

Clash spam repeats the parry input while the ball is inside Clash Distance and ping-ponging with a nearby player, capped by Max Spam Rate. Visualize draws the ball, its speed, time-to-impact, who it targets, and a clash banner and ring.
